authority: Per-image object-position for the live board's three slots. build-events-feed.mjs merges this into events.json as `crops`; the board applies it inline per . Without an entry an image gets the slot's blanket CSS default, which is what shipped beheaded dancers for weeks.
how: 2. Look at every proposal. Automated face detection is not proof (photo-directions.json).
3. Copy the ones that actually read better into this file, with `verified` and a note.
4. Re-run SYNC-TO-GITHUB.command so the feed carries them.

hero.note: 432 -> 392 on 2026-09-09: the content column below had zero slack on the tallest card and the countdown's descender sat on the base band. Any change to this height invalidates the hero crops below — re-run the gate.

thumb.note: DORMANT since the lineup redesign: the board renders .date-chip + .event-card-body and emits no thumbnail. Verified in the live DOM 2026-09-09. The thumb entries below are staged for the day it returns and reach nobody today.

winter-intensive-2027.jpg.now: the same event's own approved frame, 4000×2667 downscaled to 2000px, © Stijn Dejonckheere in EXIF. Six faces whole at both live slots, so it needs no crop entry.

deployed.how: GitHub/shoonya-tv carries a copy of this file at tv-crops.json and reads it directly; the feed's crops map takes precedence once build-events-feed.mjs lands on main.
deployed.why_a_copy: events.json is regenerated on every link-in-bio deploy. Until the generator change is merged on main, a sync would publish a feed with no crops and silently revert these frames. Keep the two copies in step: change this file, copy it to GitHub/shoonya-tv/tv-crops.json, push.
verified_live: winter-intensive-2027.jpg → new 2000×1334 photo at the slot defaults

reviewed_no_faces._: Vision detects no face in these, so no gate can judge them. CORRECTED 2026-09-09 after review: my first note claimed they were 'face-free by composition'. They are NOT — both contain visible faces the detector misses. What was actually checked is that the crop keeps the figures intact at every slot. That is a REVIEWED CROP, not an absence of faces, and it has to be re-checked by eye whenever the crop or the photo changes.
reviewed_no_faces.free-trial-week.jpg: A Shoonya yoga class in Aakash, mostly backs to camera; faces are present in the mirror and at the edges. Crop checked by eye at hero/detail: no head is cut.
reviewed_no_faces.latin-rueda-group.jpg: A rueda circle on stage. Faces ARE visible — the detector misses them against the dark ground. Crop checked by eye: no head is cut.
